scenes.prompt: @Mike as a character model sheet on a plain cream ground, 16:9, three rows with small handwritten row labels. Top row, standing neutral at identical height: front view, left side view, three-quarter view, back view. Middle row, five head-and-shoulders portraits: happy, neutral, surprised, worried, angry. Bottom row, five full-body poses: waving, thinking with a hand at the chin, presenting with an open palm toward the viewer, explaining with both hands raised, shrugging. Consistent proportions in every cell, fully visible hands and feet. A light application of woodblock print and vox newspaper with rich anime colors. Negative: no text other than the row labels, no numbers, no charts, no logos.

The same presenter as the reference image, redrawn as a flat high-contrast cartoon, as a character model sheet on a plain white ground, 16:9, three rows with small handwritten row labels. Top row, standing neutral at identical height: front view, left side view, three-quarter view, back view. Middle row, five head-and-shoulders portraits: happy, neutral, surprised, worried, angry. Bottom row, five full-body poses: waving, thinking with a hand at the chin, presenting with an open palm toward the viewer, explaining with both hands raised, shrugging. Consistent proportions in every cell, fully visible hands and feet. He keeps only short sculpted loc twists with a clean taper, black rectangular glasses, a neatly trimmed goatee, warm brown skin, a flat deep-indigo suit block and a flat copper tie block, drawn with thick uniform black outlines and solid colour fills on a plain white ground so he reads at thumbnail size. Negative: no lapel pin, no pocket square, no patterned shoes, no paper texture, no shading gradients, no text other than the row labels, no numbers, no charts, no logos.
